query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
campaign_id as "campaign_id!: i32", 
advertiser_id as "advertiser_id!: String", 
member_id as "member_id!: String", 
collab_trigger_unique_id as "collab_trigger_unique_id!: String", 
handle_id as "handle_id!: Option < i32 >", 
status as "status!: CollabStatus", 
dispute_reason as "dispute_reason!: Option < String >", 
reward as "reward!: String", 
fee as "fee!: Option < String >", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime" FROM collabs WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR campaign_id = $6::int4) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR campaign_id = ANY(CAST($8 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR advertiser_id = $10::varchar) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR advertiser_id = ANY(CAST($12 as varchar[])) ) AND (NOT $13::boolean OR member_id = $14::varchar) AND (NOT $15::boolean OR member_id = ANY(CAST($16 as varchar[])) ) AND (NOT $17::boolean OR collab_trigger_unique_id = $18::varchar) AND (NOT $19::boolean OR handle_id = $20::int4) AND (NOT $21::boolean OR handle_id = ANY(CAST($22 as int4[])) ) AND ($23::boolean IS NULL OR (($23::boolean AND handle_id IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $23::boolean AND handle_id IS NULL))) AND (NOT $24::boolean OR status = $25::collab_status) AND (NOT $26::boolean OR status != $27::collab_status) AND (NOT $28::boolean OR dispute_reason = $29::varchar) AND (NOT $30::boolean OR reward = $31::varchar) AND (NOT $32::boolean OR fee = $33::varchar) AND (NOT $34::boolean OR created_at = $35::timestamptz) AND (NOT $36::boolean OR created_at > $37::timestamptz) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($38 = 'Id' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Id' AND $39) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'CampaignId' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN campaign_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'CampaignId' AND $39) WHEN true THEN campaign_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'AdvertiserId' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN advertiser_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'AdvertiserId' AND $39) WHEN true THEN advertiser_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'MemberId' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN member_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'MemberId' AND $39) WHEN true THEN member_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'CollabTriggerUniqueId' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN collab_trigger_unique_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'CollabTriggerUniqueId' AND $39) WHEN true THEN collab_trigger_unique_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'HandleId' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN handle_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'HandleId' AND $39) WHEN true THEN handle_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Status' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Status' AND $39) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'DisputeReason' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN dispute_reason ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'DisputeReason' AND $39) WHEN true THEN dispute_reason ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Reward' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN reward ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Reward' AND $39) WHEN true THEN reward ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Fee' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN fee ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Fee' AND $39) WHEN true THEN fee ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'CreatedAt' AND $39) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $40 OFFSET $41 FOR UPDATE
